request.query: The coefficient of exponent d in the coefficient of X none to power n of an Option-variable multivariate polynomial equals its coefficient at d mapped along some plus single none n

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R →ₗ[R] R

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n d : ℕ),
  (p * Polynomial.X ^ n).coeff d = if n ≤ d then p.coeff (d - n) else 0

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n d : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.X ^ n * p).coeff d = if n ≤ d then p.coeff (d - n) else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → PowerSeries R →ₗ[R] R

items.name: Polynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → R

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_pow'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : PowerSeries R) (n d : ℕ),
  (PowerSeries.coeff d) (p * PowerSeries.X ^ n) = if n ≤ d then (PowerSeries.coeff (d - n)) p else 0

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n d : ℕ), (Polynomial.X ^ n * p).coeff (d + n) = p.coeff d
